subject: gk
question: With reference to electric charges, identify the INCORRECT statement

options.text: Lightning conductor can be used to predict lightning strike.
The electrical charges produced by rubbing are called static charges.
Lightning conductor can protect a building from lightning.
Like charges repel and unlike charges attract each other.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lightning conductor can be used to predict lightning strike. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Lightning conductor can be used to predict lightning strike."**

 
 
• This statement is **incorrect** because a lightning conductor is designed **to protect structures** from lightning, not predict it.
 
• It works by **providing a path of least resistance** for the lightning to follow and safely discharge into the ground.
 
• The** purpose of a lightning conducto**r is to divert the electric charge from a lightning strike, thus preventing damage to buildings or structures.
 
• Predicting lightning strikes requires complex meteorological analysis, which is not something a lightning conductor can do.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric charge** can be defined as an electrical attribute of matter which emerges as a result of electron accessibility or insufficiency.
 
• There are** two types of electric charges: **positive and negative charges.
 
• Charges** which are similar repel each other,** while charges that are opposite attract each other.
 
• The SI unit of **electric charge is Coulomb(C).**
